objectives.name: the relay mast
objectives.text: Get past the Static's relay mast

radio.line: Warehouse roofs. The Static use them as a lookout post, so keep your feet fast and your head down.
Ladies, gentlemen and whatever's left of you: our courier has left the building!
His name is Parker, he runs for a living, and today he's running for love. Parker, darling, you're on the air.
Let's keep it interesting. Folks, you can bet on this. Odds are he's in the Silt by lunch.
Blue panels: wallrun one, then jump to kick off to the next. That's a wall hop.
Lookouts! Say hello to the man of the hour.
Three gunners. Watch for the red laser: that's a shot coming, so move. Click the mouse wheel when it gets busy: time slows for a few seconds. Use it.
Oh, he shoots too. Echo, darling, you never mentioned that.
That mast is their relay. Get past it and you're out of their sight. Wall on your left this time.
He's quick, folks! Quicker than my last three couriers, may they rest in pieces.
Stay tuned. Next on the show: the Glass District, where the windows are sharp and my toll collectors are sharper.
Ignore him. Catch your breath, then we go.

bail.line: Ooh! That one's going in the highlights.
Did everyone hear that? I think that was his pride.
Down he goes! Echo, you married this?

combo.line: Look at him go! Echo, are you watching? Oh, you're tied up. Ha!
Moves like that, I might have to start paying him.
The phones are ringing, folks. Well, they would be, if we had phones.

fall.line: And he's down! A quick dust bath in the Silt.
Back up you go. Don't give him the satisfaction.

kill.line: That was a good lookout. He looked out. Briefly.

down.line: And our courier takes a nap! Somebody fetch him a pillow.
Up. Don't stand still in their sights: run, then shoot.

do.label: ON AIR: reach the relay mast

radio.line: Road barriers. Jump into them and you'll vault without slowing.
Gap's too wide. Wall on the right, same as home.

do.label: Wallrun the blue wall across the gap
Wallrun, then jump: hop to the other wall
